name: How long does a garage conversion ADU project usually take from start to finish?
description: A garage conversion ADU project typically takes 4 to 8 months, with 1-3 months for design and permitting, and 3-5 months for construction.

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage conversion ADU project usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage conversion ADU project typically ranges from 4 to 8 months, but this can vary. Design and permitting usually take 1 to 3 months, depending on the complexity of the plans and the speed of local city approvals. Construction itself generally takes 3 to 5 months, influenced by the scope of work, material availability, and inspection schedules. We work to streamline the process, providing clear timelines and regular updates throughout the project.
